snippet.title: Of Peaks and Tides - Official Animated Trailer
snippet.description: This animated trailer introduces you to Of Peaks and Tides' world, where civilizations built by human tribes once thrived and lived in harmony. But that peace was destroyed by a war of the gods, who abandoned the land and let it fall victim to flooding, sandstorms, and blizzards. Now, it's up to you to survive this harsh land, reclaim it, and help rebuild.
